description: This file implements Google Chat message actions, including sending messages, uploading files, reacting to messages, and listing reactions. It defines the 'googlechatMessageActions' object with methods for describing message tools, extracting tool send data, and handling various actions.

methods.name: listEnabledAccounts
methods.description: Filters enabled Google Chat accounts from configuration.

methods.name: isReactionsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if reactions are enabled for given accounts based on action gates.

methods.name: resolveAppUserNames
methods.description: Resolves set of application user names for reactions.

methods.name: loadGoogleChatActionMedia
methods.description: Loads media from a URL or local source, respecting size limits.
